rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and audited contemporaneous repository behavior. Require observable outcomes supported by those sources, including preservation of compatible existing behavior. Treat exact code structure, algorithms, representations, validation mechanisms, messages, refactors, test form or location, and documentation as incidental unless explicitly required. Use later patches and tests only as evidence of behavior or non-regression: they may reveal or confirm a relevant outcome, including closely analogous cases, but cannot retroactively make broader coverage or a particular implementation mandatory. Penalize unsupported behavior, broadened scope, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that satisfies the supported observable contract.
